itens.titulo: Ethereum Analysis: Could ETH Fall to $2,180 and Liquidate a $214 Million Whale?
itens.descricao: Ethereum Analysis: Could ETH Fall to $2,180 and Liquidate a $214 Million Whale? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - A Lookonchain-tracked whale holds $214 million in ETH long positions, is down $18.6 million, and faces forced liquidation near $2,180.
- Spot Ether ETFs shed $225 million in weekly outflows, stripping away a consistent buyer as ETH slides 13.6% through October.
- A daily ETH close below $2,276 would put the whale's $2,182 liquidation price in play, with no meaningful support until $1,820.
Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) is trading about 6% above the critical $2,180 level, where a whale's massive $214 million long position is at risk of liquidation, according to on-chain tracker Lookonchain.
Ethereum was at $2,315 on the morning of October 26, 2026, down 0.7% in the past 24 hours and 13.2% for the month of October.
Recently, ETH hit a low of $2,276 on October 24, marking the month's lowest point.
So, what has caused this shift, and is a drop to $2,180 possible?
On October 26, Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) also dipped as investors became cautious ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting.

itens.titulo: Lumentum and Coherent Stocks Jump 3% as StoneX Unveils Bold Price Targets
itens.descricao: Lumentum and Coherent Stocks Jump 3% as StoneX Unveils Bold Price Targets Yahoo Finance
trechos: Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) and Coherent (NYSE:COHR) shares each rose about 3% in morning trading Monday after StoneX initiated coverage of both optical networking companies with Buy ratings and price targets of $1,200 and $425, respectively.
The timeline has shifted to late 2027 and early 2028, with NPO and co-packaged optics potentially taking similar shares of the market.
GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Sign with COHR.
Acree cited plans to double capacity in the September quarter and more than double it again by the end of 2027.
Facilities in Texas and Sweden are expected to support the expansion, while production in Zurich is planned for the first half of 2027.
Coherent also expects quarterly revenue to exceed $3 billion by the end of fiscal 2027.
Its initial co-packaged optics production ramp is planned for late 2026, followed by further expansion in 2027.

17 report is the next thing to watch.

Alibaba (BABA:NYSE), ByteDance and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million of NVIDIA's RTX PRO 5500 cards, a less powerful chip that complies with US export rules, with a sticker price of more than $35 billion, Reuters reported.

That's billions of dollars of Chinese demand NVIDIA could go after.

itens.titulo: A reação de CEO da Petrobras (PETR4) após vitória de Lula; ‘a hora é de comprar’
itens.descricao: A reação de CEO da Petrobras (PETR4) após vitória de Lula; ‘a hora é de comprar’ Money Times
itens.texto:
A reação de CEO da Petrobras (PETR4) após vitória de Lula; ‘a hora é de comprar’
A presidente da Petrobras (PETR4), Magda Chambriard, afirmou nesta segunda-feira que a forte queda nas ações da estatal após a reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi um “movimento especulativo” e não reflete os fundamentos da empresa.
Em entrevista à Reuters, Chambriard disse que a Petrobras continua sendo uma empresa sólida, com uma forte carteira de investimentos, e que não se deixará influenciar por movimentos de curto prazo do mercado.
“A hora é de comprar (ações). Infelizmente não posso”, disse a executiva.
As ações da Petrobras negociadas na B3 caíam cerca de 10% nesta segunda-feira após o presidente Lula derrotar o senador Flávio Bolsonaro no segundo turno das eleições de domingo, contrariando as pesquisas e garantindo um quarto mandato não consecutivo.
